data.one_liner: High-performance spreadsheet widget supporting large datasets, zoom, and tile rendering.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter spreadsheet widget that displays and edits tabular data using GPU-optimized tile-based rendering. It supports large datasets, 10%-400% zoom, cell merging, formulas, and keyboard navigation.
use_when: You need to display and edit large spreadsheet-style tabular data at 60fps.
Your application requires Excel-like features such as zooming, cell selection, and formulas.
avoid_when: You only need a basic, simple data table without heavy spreadsheet capabilities.
You do not require high-performance tile rendering or sparse dataset memory management.
strengths: Maintains 60fps performance with large datasets through GPU-optimized tile-based rendering.
Sparse storage handles hundreds of thousands of rows efficiently.
Built-in support for zoom, cell merging, rich text, and extensive keyboard navigation.
weaknesses: Specialized widget with a very specific spreadsheet domain, not suited for general layout tasks.
Requires learning its specific data and controller APIs.
